t: This is Monument for a Dead Parrot, a sculpture in Greenwich by John Reardon. Reardon, a sculptor born in 1968, made the piece. The title is a playful nod to a famous comedy sketch about a parrot, and it invites you to smile as you look. A monument to a dead bird is a funny idea, so see how the work balances the humour with the solemn tradition of memorials. I don't have more details about its date or materials, so enjoy it as it stands.
